segments.text: Day one. I did everything right.

subs.text:
Day one.
I did everything right.

segments.text: I nailed boards over the front door and told myself they would hold. Then I looked through the window. There were so many of them.

subs.text:
I nailed boards over the front door and told
myself they would hold.
Then I looked through the window.
There were so many of them.

segments.text: Day two, they were still there. Day three... they still hadn't moved. So I got comfortable. I stopped sleeping behind the barricade. That was my mistake.

subs.text: Day two, they were still there.
Day three... they still hadn't moved.
I stopped sleeping behind the barricade.

segments.text: Because they weren't trying to get in. They were looking at me the way you look at someone who doesn't know yet.

subs.text: Because they weren't trying to get in.

They were looking at me the way you look at
someone who doesn't know yet.

segments.text: Then one of them pressed its hand against the glass... and pointed up. I had been sleeping under that hatch for three days.

subs.text:

segments.text: So I did the only thing left. I opened the door. And they stepped aside.

subs.text:
